create_bigbird_block: create a BigBirdBlock transformer layer with BigBird sparse attention for long-range sequence modeling
build_bigbird_attention: build a BigBirdSelfAttention module with block-sparse and random attention patterns
configure_bigbird_block: configure a BigBirdBlock with custom embedding dimension, attention heads, and MLP dimensions
apply_bigbird_block: apply a BigBirdBlock to input tensors with optional padding masks and segmentation for packed examples
test_bigbird_block: test the BigBirdBlock module with deterministic and non-deterministic forward passes
